summary: NextCure filed an 8-K disclosing a Delaware Court of Chancery petition under DGCL Section 205 seeking validation of its July 10, 2025 Certificate of Amendment effecting a 1:12 reverse stock split and all shares issued in reliance on it. The 2025 annual meeting approved the split with 18,166,577 votes for, 2,028,946 against (89.92% of votes cast; 64.76% of outstanding). The court ordered this disclosure and set a hearing for November 6, 2026. Watch for validation risk to prior financings and Nasdaq listing compliance.
